name: Smart Temperature Display Bottle
subtitle: 500ml insulated stainless steel flask
description: This 500ml smart temperature display bottle combines a 304 stainless steel body with double-wall vacuum insulation and an LED touch cap. Tap the cap to check the liquid temperature, while the leak-proof design supports convenient carrying for hot or cold beverages.
story: Designed for everyday hydration, this insulated flask lets you check your drink temperature directly from the touch display on the cap. Its 500ml capacity is suitable for carrying water, tea, coffee, or other hot and cold beverages during office hours, travel, gym sessions, or daily commuting. The double-wall vacuum construction provides insulation, while the stainless steel bottle body offers a practical reusable alternative to disposable drink containers. Multi-brand custom branding can be applied where required, without representing an incorrectly registered brand logo.

specs.custom_branding: Multi-brand custom branding supported; logo registration not verified

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
